calibration.method: from-scratch direct rank-10 field-lattice replay from the E8+A1 height-zero cone

conclusion: The exhaustive 3+6*phi level contributes ten walls.  All ten are strict on the previous spacelike extreme ray, so the 71-wall outer cone still has that exact hyperideal escape and is not of finite volume.
scope: The direct norm-two Vinberg search is exhaustive only through control coordinate 3+6*phi (equivalently through identity bound 13).  Later simple roots may cut the displayed hyperideal ray.
